overall: The AG found a violation for failing to conspicuously record the posting date and time on the original notice, but found no violation on the other allegation and ordered no additional relief given good faith.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the commission's amended February 20, 2014 meeting notice was not posted 48 hours before the meeting.
Complainant alleged the commission discussed topics at its February 20, 2014 meeting that were not listed at least 48 hours in advance.
allegations.key_passage: We do not find any evidence to support the complainant's other allegation, that the Commission discussed topics during its February 20, 2014 meeting that were not listed at least 48 hours in advance of the meeting.

allegations.summary: Original notice did not conspicuously record the date and time it was posted; the stamped date and time were indecipherable.
allegations.key_passage: However, because the date and time that the notice was posted are indecipherable, we find that the notice did not comply with the law's requirements.
